modal.title: Instructions
modal.body:
Before proceeding, read the following instructions:

It is implied in this setup that you are warmed up. If not, press Cancel and proceed after being warmed up.

You have to do {noReps} repetitions of {title}.

You will have to click the record button and then position yourself in front of the camera until the border color turns green.

You will proceed to train according to the selected exercise and do up to {noReps} repetitions.

When you're done, click on the record button to stop the recording session and proceed to the feedback form.

By clicking Ok, you confirm that you've read the instructions.

abs.title: Abs
abs.description: You must do some abs in order to determine your core fitness. It is recommended to position yourself sideways of your camera.

pushups.title: Pushups
pushups.description: You must do some pushups in order to determine your chest fitness. It is recommended to position yourself sideways of your camera.

squats.title: Squats
squats.description: You must do some squats in order to determine your legs fitness. It is recommended to position yourself in front of your camera.

noReps.description: How many repetitions have you completed?
noReps.invalid: You should have completed between 1 and {noReps} repetitions.

rir.description: How many extra repetitions can you still do?
rir.invalid: You should be able to do 1 to {maxLimit} more repetitions.

about.title: About
about.body:
Who are we?

We are a team from Politehnica University of Bucharest and are researching Computer Vision applied in sports and fitness.

What are we researching?

Our research scope is to determine motion fatigue and correlate it with perceived psychological fatigue.

What to expect?

We expect that you, the user, respect the provided instructions. The fitness set can be done by every individual, regardess of fitness level.
